q18801.en: When there are children waiting at the traffic light you must be careful, because they could suddenly cross the road as soon as the vehicle traffic light changes from green to yellow.

explain.short: Children often see the yellow light for cars as their chance to go. They may run out at that moment.
explain.rule: Children can act suddenly at a traffic light (semaforo). Be ready to slow down and stop, even when your light is green.
explain.trap: 'improvvisamente' (suddenly) is the key idea: children do not wait for the perfect moment.

sceneParams.caption: Light turns yellow: children may run out
lines: Slow down, be ready to stop

keywords.en: children waiting at the traffic light

q18802.en: When there are children waiting at the traffic light you must be careful, because they could quickly cross the road even on red, thinking it lasts too long.

explain.short: Children get impatient. If the red seems long, they may run across anyway.
explain.rule: Children can act suddenly at a traffic light (semaforo). Be ready to slow down and stop, even when your light is green.
explain.trap: 'anche con il rosso' (even on red): children do not always respect their red light.

sceneParams.caption: Impatient children may cross on red
lines: Slow down, be ready to stop

q18803.en: When there are children waiting at the traffic light you must be careful, because they may push each other and end up on the carriageway.

explain.short: Children play and push each other. One of them can fall into the road without wanting to.
explain.rule: Children can act suddenly at a traffic light (semaforo). Be ready to slow down and stop, even when your light is green.
explain.trap: 'si spingano a vicenda' means 'push each other': a child can end up in the road by accident.

sceneParams.caption: Children playing may fall into the road
lines: One may fall into the road
Slow down, be ready to stop

q18804.en: When there are children waiting at the traffic light you must be careful, because they could step down from the pavement onto the carriageway while their light is still red.

explain.short: Children may step off the pavement before their light turns green. They can be in the road while it is still red for them.
explain.rule: Children can act suddenly at a traffic light (semaforo). Be ready to slow down and stop, even when your light is green.
explain.trap: 'quando ancora per loro il semaforo è disposto al rosso' (while their light is still red): they do not always wait.

sceneParams.caption: Children may step off the pavement on red

q18805.en: Before entering a junction, after the traffic light has turned green, the driver must wait until pedestrians have finished crossing the road.

explain.short: Green lets you go, but pedestrians still on the road must finish crossing first. You never drive into people.
explain.rule: A green light does not cancel pedestrians already crossing. Let them reach the other side, then go.
explain.trap: 'abbiano finito di attraversare' (have finished crossing): green does not mean 'go at once'.

sceneParams.caption: Green light: let pedestrians finish crossing

q18806.en: When there are children waiting at the traffic light, you must keep in mind that they can cross the road only if accompanied by an adult.

explain.short: Children can cross alone. No rule says they need an adult, so you must watch out for them anyway.
explain.rule: Children can act suddenly at a traffic light (semaforo). Be ready to slow down and stop, even when your light is green.
explain.trap: 'solo se accompagnati' (only if accompanied) is false: children often cross alone.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: children may cross alone, without adults

q18807.en: Children at the traffic light can cross the road only after receiving a sign of consent from drivers.

explain.short: Pedestrians follow their own traffic light, not drivers' gestures. And children may cross without waiting for anyone.
explain.rule: Children can act suddenly at a traffic light (semaforo). Be ready to slow down and stop, even when your light is green.
explain.trap: 'solo dopo aver ricevuto un gesto di consenso' (only after a gesture of consent): there is no such rule.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no driver gesture is needed

q18808.en: When there are children waiting at the traffic light, you can be sure that they will cross the road only when the pedestrian light is green.

explain.short: You can never be sure what children will do. They may cross on red or on yellow.
explain.rule: Children can act suddenly at a traffic light (semaforo). Be ready to slow down and stop, even when your light is green.
explain.trap: 'si può essere certi' (you can be sure) is the trap: with children you are never sure.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: you can never be sure with children
lines: Slow down, be ready to stop

q18809.en: When there are children waiting at the traffic light, you can be sure that they will not cross the road if the light is flashing yellow.

explain.short: Flashing yellow means the light is not regulating traffic. Children may well cross, so you must be careful.
explain.rule: Children can act suddenly at a traffic light (semaforo). Be ready to slow down and stop, even when your light is green.
explain.trap: 'si può essere certi che non attraverseranno' (you can be sure they won't cross): never sure with children.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow: children may still cross

q18810.en: When driving, near a stop for a bus carrying schoolchildren, you must watch out for children who may have started crossing the carriageway hidden by the bus.

explain.short: A stopped bus hides children behind it. They can appear in front of you without warning.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'nascosti dall'autobus' (hidden by the bus): you may not see them until the last moment.

sceneParams.caption: Children may be hidden by the bus
lines: Slow down, be ready to brake

q18811.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, you must watch out for children, who may run across the road to get on the school bus.

explain.short: Children in a hurry to catch the bus run across without looking.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'di corsa' (running): a child late for the bus does not look at cars.

sceneParams.caption: Children may run to catch the bus
lines: Slow down, be ready to brake

q18812.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, you must be ready to brake in case children suddenly cross the road.

explain.short: Children can run out at any moment. Being ready to brake gives you time to stop.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'prepararsi a frenare' (be ready to brake): foot ready, speed low.

sceneParams.caption: Be ready to brake near a school bus stop
lines: Slow down, be ready to brake

q18813.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, you must be careful and take into account the unpredictable behaviour of children.

explain.short: Children do not think like drivers. Expect them to do something unexpected.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'comportamenti imprevedibili' (unpredictable behaviour): plan for the unexpected.

sceneParams.caption: Children are unpredictable: be careful
lines: Slow down, be ready to brake

q18814.en: Near a school bus stop, children may get off the bus without paying attention to oncoming vehicles.

explain.short: Children getting off the bus often think only of going home. They may not look at the traffic.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'senza fare attenzione' (without paying attention): you must pay attention for them.

sceneParams.caption: Children leave the bus without looking
lines: They may not look at cars
Slow down, be ready to brake

q18815.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, you must slow down especially if the school bus is there.

explain.short: A school bus at the stop means children are getting on or off right now. That is the moment of most danger.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'particolarmente' (especially): with the bus present, slow down even more.

sceneParams.caption: School bus at the stop: slow down even more

q18816.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, you must not slow down, so as not to hinder the traffic of other vehicles.

explain.short: Children's safety comes before traffic flow. Near a school bus stop you must slow down.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'non si deve rallentare' (you must not slow down) is the opposite of the rule.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: you must slow down, safety first

q18817.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, you must go first, always having priority over children crossing the road.

explain.short: Drivers do not have priority over children crossing. You must let them cross safely.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'avendo sempre la precedenza' (always having priority): drivers never get priority over children on the road.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: let crossing children go first

q18818.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, you must use the horn to make children crossing on the zebra crossing give way.

explain.short: Pedestrians on a zebra crossing have priority. The horn could also frighten children and make them run.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'suonare per invitare... a dare la precedenza' (honk so they give way): it is you who gives way.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: on the crossing children have priority

q18819.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, you must slow down only if there are children crossing.

explain.short: You slow down before you see them: children can appear suddenly from behind the bus.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'solo se' (only if) is the trap: you slow down anyway, not only when you see children.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: slow down even if you see no children
lines: Slow down, be ready to brake

q18820.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, you must watch out for the school bus, which after stopping will certainly reverse.

explain.short: A bus does not reverse after a stop. The danger near the stop is the children.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'sicuramente retromarcia' (will certainly reverse): an invented danger.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the danger is the children, not reversing
lines: Slow down, be ready to brake

q18821.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, you cannot continue driving if the doors of the school bus are still open.

explain.short: No rule forces you to stop just because the doors are open. You may go on, slowly and carefully.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'non si può proseguire' (you cannot continue): there is no ban, only a duty to be careful.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: you may go on, slowly and carefully

q18822.en: When driving, near a school bus stop, it is not necessary to slow down if the school bus is stopped.

explain.short: A stopped school bus is the most dangerous moment: children are getting on or off. You must slow down.
explain.rule: Near a school bus stop (piazzola di fermata per scolari) slow down and be ready to stop. Children are unpredictable and may run across, also hidden by the bus.
explain.trap: 'non è necessario rallentare' (no need to slow down) is the opposite of the rule.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: bus stopped means slow down

keywords.en: it is not necessary to slow down

q18823.en: The driver, near a taxi rank, must slow down and if necessary stop if there are pedestrians crossing the road without looking.

explain.short: People rushing to or from a taxi often cross without looking. You must slow down and stop if needed.
explain.rule: Near a taxi rank (posteggio riservato ai taxi) watch for people getting in and out and crossing suddenly. Taxis leaving the rank give way to you. Other vehicles may never park there.
explain.trap: 'senza guardare' (without looking): you must be the one who looks.

sceneParams.caption: Pedestrians near taxis may cross without looking

q18824.en: The driver, near a taxi rank, must watch out for pedestrians getting into or out of the taxi.

explain.short: People get in and out of taxis on the road side too. They can step in front of you.
explain.rule: Near a taxi rank (posteggio riservato ai taxi) watch for people getting in and out and crossing suddenly. Taxis leaving the rank give way to you. Other vehicles may never park there.
explain.trap: 'salgono o scendono' (get in or out): doors open and people move near the traffic.

sceneParams.caption: Watch people getting in and out of taxis

q18825.en: The driver of a vehicle other than a taxi cannot park in the spaces reserved for taxis.

explain.short: Taxi spaces are only for taxis. Other vehicles may not park (sostare) there.
explain.rule: Near a taxi rank (posteggio riservato ai taxi) watch for people getting in and out and crossing suddenly. Taxis leaving the rank give way to you. Other vehicles may never park there.
explain.trap: 'diverso dai taxi' (other than taxis): only taxis can use these spaces.

sceneParams.caption: Taxi spaces: only for taxis

q18826.en: The driver, near a taxi rank, must watch out for pedestrians, who may suddenly cross the road without due care.

explain.short: People running to a taxi may cross suddenly and carelessly. You must be ready for it.
explain.rule: Near a taxi rank (posteggio riservato ai taxi) watch for people getting in and out and crossing suddenly. Taxis leaving the rank give way to you. Other vehicles may never park there.
explain.trap: 'senza le dovute precauzioni' (without due care): pedestrians may be careless, so you must not be.

sceneParams.caption: Pedestrians may cross suddenly near taxis

q18827.en: The driver, near a taxi rank, must give way to taxis entering the road.

explain.short: A taxi leaving its rank joins the traffic, so it must give way to you, like any car pulling out.
explain.rule: Near a taxi rank (posteggio riservato ai taxi) watch for people getting in and out and crossing suddenly. Taxis leaving the rank give way to you. Other vehicles may never park there.
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza ai taxi' (must give way to taxis): taxis have no special priority.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the taxi pulling out gives way to you
lines: It must give way to you

q18828.en: The driver, near a taxi rank, must give way to departing taxis if they enter from the left side of the carriageway.

explain.short: Taxis pulling out give way to traffic, from either side. Their side of the road changes nothing.
explain.rule: Near a taxi rank (posteggio riservato ai taxi) watch for people getting in and out and crossing suddenly. Taxis leaving the rank give way to you. Other vehicles may never park there.
explain.trap: 'qualora s'immettano dal lato sinistro' (if they come from the left): the side does not matter.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: from any side, the taxi gives way

q18829.en: The driver of a vehicle other than a taxi can park in the spaces reserved for taxis from 8 p.m. to 8 a.m.

explain.short: Taxi spaces are reserved at all times. There is no night exception for other vehicles.
explain.rule: Near a taxi rank (posteggio riservato ai taxi) watch for people getting in and out and crossing suddenly. Taxis leaving the rank give way to you. Other vehicles may never park there.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 20.00 alle ore 8.00' (from 8 p.m. to 8 a.m.): an invented time window.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: taxi spaces are reserved day and night

q18830.en: When the carriageway is occupied by cyclists or pedestrians, to overtake them it is wise to keep an adequate lateral safety distance.

explain.short: Cyclists and pedestrians have no protection. A wide side gap keeps them safe if they move sideways.
explain.rule: You may overtake cyclists and pedestrians on the road, with great care and a wide enough side gap. If there is not enough room, wait. Outside towns a short horn warning is advisable.
explain.trap: 'distanza di sicurezza laterale' (side safety distance): the space at your side, not in front.

sceneParams.caption: Overtake cyclists with a wide side gap

q18831.en: When the carriageway is occupied by cyclists or pedestrians, it is not wise to overtake them if you cannot keep a sufficient lateral distance.

explain.short: Without enough side space, passing could hit or frighten them. Wait until there is room.
explain.rule: You may overtake cyclists and pedestrians on the road, with great care and a wide enough side gap. If there is not enough room, wait. Outside towns a short horn warning is advisable.
explain.trap: 'se non si può rispettare' (if you cannot keep): no space means no overtaking.

sceneParams.caption: No side room: wait behind

keywords.en: it is not wise to overtake them

q18832.en: When a carriageway outside built-up areas is occupied by cyclists or pedestrians, it is advisable to sound the horn before overtaking them.

explain.short: Outside towns traffic is faster. A short horn warning tells them you are coming so they do not swerve.
explain.rule: You may overtake cyclists and pedestrians on the road, with great care and a wide enough side gap. If there is not enough room, wait. Outside towns a short horn warning is advisable.
explain.trap: 'extraurbana' (outside towns) matters: there a short warning with the horn is allowed and useful.

sceneParams.caption: Outside towns: a short horn warning helps
lines: Then pass with a wide gap

q18833.en: A driver who intends to overtake cyclists or pedestrians occupying the carriageway must be very careful.

explain.short: Cyclists and pedestrians are vulnerable and can move unexpectedly. Overtaking them needs a lot of care.
explain.rule: You may overtake cyclists and pedestrians on the road, with great care and a wide enough side gap. If there is not enough room, wait. Outside towns a short horn warning is advisable.
explain.trap: 'molta prudenza' (great care): overtaking is allowed, but carefully.

sceneParams.caption: Overtaking cyclists: great care

q18834.en: Since cyclists sometimes ride with slight wobbles, a driver must take this into account when overtaking.

explain.short: A cyclist can wobble sideways, for example on a bump or in wind. A wide gap leaves room for that.
explain.rule: You may overtake cyclists and pedestrians on the road, with great care and a wide enough side gap. If there is not enough room, wait. Outside towns a short horn warning is advisable.
explain.trap: 'leggeri sbandamenti' (slight wobbles): the cyclist may move toward you.

sceneParams.caption: Cyclists wobble: leave extra side room

q18835.en: A driver who intends to overtake cyclists or pedestrians occupying the carriageway must keep a lateral distance of at least 2 metres.

explain.short: The side gap must be adequate and safe, but the quiz has no fixed '2 metres' rule.
explain.rule: You may overtake cyclists and pedestrians on the road, with great care and a wide enough side gap. If there is not enough room, wait. Outside towns a short horn warning is advisable.
explain.trap: 'almeno 2 metri' (at least 2 metres): an invented exact number.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no fixed 2-metre rule, just a safe gap

q18836.en: It is forbidden to overtake cyclists or pedestrians occupying the carriageway.

explain.short: Overtaking them is allowed. You just need great care and enough side space.
explain.rule: You may overtake cyclists and pedestrians on the road, with great care and a wide enough side gap. If there is not enough room, wait. Outside towns a short horn warning is advisable.
explain.trap: 'E' vietato' (it is forbidden): there is no general ban.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: allowed, with care and a wide gap

q18837.en: At night, the driver does not have to give way to pedestrians crossing on the zebra crossing.

explain.short: Pedestrians on a zebra crossing have priority day and night. At night you must be even more careful.
explain.rule: On a zebra crossing (strisce pedonali) you always give way to pedestrians, at any hour.
explain.trap: 'di notte' (at night): the rule does not change with the time of day.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: give way on the crossing, day and night

q18838.en: When the carriageway is occupied by cyclists or pedestrians, they must be overtaken without exceeding 30 km/h.

explain.short: There is no special 30 km/h limit for this. You adapt your speed and keep a safe side gap.
explain.rule: You may overtake cyclists and pedestrians on the road, with great care and a wide enough side gap. If there is not enough room, wait. Outside towns a short horn warning is advisable.
explain.trap: '30 km/h' is an invented limit: the rule is care and side distance.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no 30 km/h rule, adapt your speed

q18839.en: The driver must let a pregnant woman cross the road without rushing her.

explain.short: A pregnant woman may walk slowly and must not be put under pressure. Wait calmly.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'senza metterle fretta' (without rushing her): no horn, no creeping forward.

sceneParams.caption: Let her cross calmly, don't rush her

q18840.en: You must be more careful with pregnant women crossing the road.

explain.short: Pregnant women move more slowly and a scare or a fall is more dangerous for them.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'maggiore prudenza' (more care): extra care, not normal care.

sceneParams.caption: Extra care for pregnant women crossing

q18841.en: You must be more careful with pedestrians pushing a pram.

explain.short: A pram sticks out in front of the person and is slow to move. A child is inside.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'carrozzina per bambini' (pram): the pram may enter the road before you see the adult.

sceneParams.caption: Extra care for people with a pram

q18842.en: When parking a vehicle, it is forbidden to block kerb ramps, so as not to stop pedestrians pushing a pram from passing.

explain.short: Kerb ramps (scivoli) let prams and wheelchairs go up and down the pavement. Blocking them is not allowed.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'scivoli del marciapiede' (kerb ramps): the low parts of the pavement edge.

sceneParams.caption: Never park in front of kerb ramps

q18843.en: When a pregnant woman is crossing the carriageway you must not get too close with the vehicle, so as not to frighten her.

explain.short: A car coming too close can frighten her and make her hurry or fall. Stop at a distance.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'avvicinarsi troppo' (get too close): keep your distance and wait.

sceneParams.caption: Keep your distance, don't frighten her

q18844.en: When a pregnant woman is crossing the carriageway you must keep in mind that she walks faster and so crosses quickly.

explain.short: It is the opposite: a pregnant woman usually walks more slowly, so she needs more time.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'passo più rapido' (faster step): the opposite of the truth.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: she walks more slowly, give her time

q18845.en: When a pedestrian pushing a pram is crossing the carriageway, you must keep in mind that, usually, they cross quickly.

explain.short: With a pram people move slowly and carefully. Expect them to need time.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'attraversa rapidamente' (crosses quickly): with a pram, the opposite is true.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: with a pram people cross slowly

q18846.en: It is permitted to park a vehicle in front of kerb ramps only from 10 p.m. to 8 a.m.

explain.short: Kerb ramps must stay free at all hours. There is no night exception.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'solo dalle ore 22.00 alle ore 8.00' (only 10 p.m. to 8 a.m.): an invented time window.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: kerb ramps stay free day and night

q18847.en: When a pregnant woman is crossing the carriageway you must give way to her only if she crosses from left to right.

explain.short: You give way to pedestrians crossing whatever direction they come from.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'solo se attraversa da sinistra a destra' (only from left to right): direction does not matter.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: give way from any direction

q18848.en: When a pedestrian pushing a pram is crossing the carriageway you must give way to them only if they cross from left to right.

explain.short: You give way to a pedestrian with a pram from either side. Direction changes nothing.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'solo se attraversa da sinistra a destra' (only from left to right): direction does not matter.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: give way from any direction

q18849.en: It is permitted to leave the vehicle parked on the pavement without leaving space for pedestrians pushing a pram.

explain.short: The pavement (marciapiede) is for pedestrians. You may not park there and block their way.
explain.rule: Pregnant women and people pushing a pram (carrozzina) walk slowly: give way from any side, never rush them, keep your distance. Never block kerb ramps (scivoli) or the pavement.
explain.trap: 'E' consentito' (it is permitted): parking on the pavement and blocking it is not allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: never block the pavement
